situation: My aunt Linda comments on my weight at every family dinner. I've deflected it at least five times. Thanksgiving is next month and I want to text her before then.
reply: Aunt Linda, I know you mean well, and I need you to stop commenting on my weight. It's off the table. I'd love to talk about anything else at Thanksgiving. See you there.
note: This is the firmer version; if it comes up at the table anyway, go help in the kitchen, no announcement.

situation: 每年过年大伯都当着一桌人问我一个月挣多少，我不想说，也不想让场面尴尬。大伯退休后在院子里种了个小菜园。
reply: 哈哈，大伯又来查账了。够我明年请您吃饭的。对了，您那个小菜园今年收成怎么样？
note: 如果他再问一次，用几乎一样的话再说一遍，一致比换花样更能让话题结束。

situation: 実家に帰るたびに母から「結婚はまだ？」と聞かれます。けんかにはしたくないけど、そろそろやめてほしい。母は先月、友達と旅行に行ってきたばかりです。
reply: お母さん、心配してくれてるのはわかってるよ。でも結婚の話はしばらくお休みにさせて。それ以外ならなんでも話したいから。そういえば、この前の旅行の写真見せてよ。
note: 家族によっては、こういう柔らかい区切り方だけで十分はっきり伝わります。強い言い方は、それでも何度も聞いてくる人のために取っておきましょう。

situation: I finally texted my mum asking her to stop asking when I'm moving back to Manila. She replied 'So I can't even ask my own daughter anything now.' She sounds really hurt. I'm flying home for Christmas on 19 December.
reply: Mum, I love you and I want our calls to be good ones. That's exactly why I'm asking for this one subject to rest. Ask me anything else, any time, and I'm still coming home for Christmas, my flight lands on the 19th.
note: When a parent hears the boundary as rejection, speak to the relationship, not the topic, and don't reopen the subject to comfort her.

situation: My husband's parents ask 'so when are you giving us a grandchild?' at every family dinner. We're in the middle of IVF and don't want to tell anyone yet. Diwali dinner is at their place in a few weeks.
reply: Ha, when there's news, you'll be the first to know, Mummy-ji. Now tell me, what are you making for Diwali this year?
note: No reason given, since 'we're trying' invites advice; if it comes back, repeat the same line nearly word for word.

situation: My brother Mike and his wife just separated. Aunt Carol, who's been redoing her kitchen all summer, texted me 'So what really happened with Mike and Jen?? Was it her?' I'm not going to gossip about my brother.
reply: Hi Aunt Carol, that's Mike's story to tell, not mine, so I'll leave it with him. If you want to know how he is, give him a ring. How's the kitchen renovation going?
note: When the nosy question is about someone else, decline on their behalf, point her to the person, and change the subject. No hints about who was at fault.

situation: 我在上海做游戏策划，干得挺开心。每次打电话我妈都劝我回老家考公务员，说图个稳定。她前阵子说想学用手机拍视频。国庆要回家待五天，我不想一回去就吵起来。
reply: 妈，我知道您是担心我，想让我稳当点。工作这块我现在挺好的，有什么变化第一个告诉您。对了，您说想学用手机拍视频，这次回去我教您，顺便给您和我爸拍几张好看的照片。
note: 不解释理由，解释就是在邀请对方给建议；她第二次问，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: Minha sogra, dona Célia, pergunta toda semana quando vamos batizar a Lívia, que tem seis meses. A gente ainda não decidiu se vai batizar e não quer discutir isso com ela. Domingo tem almoço na casa dela.
reply: Ah, dona Célia, a senhora não esquece nunca, né? Quando a gente tiver novidade, a senhora vai ser a primeira a saber. Agora me conta, qual é a sobremesa de hoje?
note: Não explicar a dúvida sobre o batismo: explicação vira convite para conselho. Se ela voltar ao assunto, repetir a mesma frase quase igual.

situation: Every year my grandma asks if I'll come to midnight Mass with the family on Christmas Eve. I stopped going to church years ago and I'm not going, but she's 88 and I don't want to hurt her. The family has dinner at her house after Mass, and I'm happy to come at 6 to help cook. She asked again on the phone this week.
reply: I know how much Christmas Eve Mass means to you, Nana, and I love that you want us all there. I won't be coming to Mass, but I'll be at the house by 6 on the 24th to help with dinner. What are you cooking this year?
note: A direct invitation needs a clear answer, but no reasons about faith, which only open a debate. Give her a warm, specific plan, redirect, and repeat the same line if she asks again.

situation: 家族微信群里二姨当着所有人@我：“老二什么时候安排上？你家朵朵都四岁了。”二姨的女儿下个月办婚礼。我和老公还没想好要不要二胎，不想在群里解释，也不想让二姨下不来台。
reply: 哈哈，二姨您比我们还着急。有消息一定第一个告诉您。对了，表妹下个月办婚礼，酒店定好了吗？
note: 群里当众问，就在群里轻松一句带过、马上换话题，不解释；她私聊再问，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: My divorce from Mark was finalised in June. At my cousin's wedding on Saturday my great-aunt Rosa will definitely ask what happened, probably at the dinner table. I don't want to talk about it or make a scene.
reply: Ah, Aunt Rosa, straight in. It's done, I'm doing well, and that's the whole story. Now tell me, who are you betting will be first on the dance floor tonight?
note: If she asks again, repeat 'It's done, I'm doing well' word for word; any reason you give becomes the next question.

situation: 国庆回老家，一大家子吃饭时，我婶婶每次都当着我儿子小宇（10岁）的面问他期中考了第几名，还拿他跟表哥比，说表哥次次第一。孩子每次都低着头不说话。他最近在搭一个航母模型。这次想提前想好怎么接。
reply: 哈哈，婶婶又来考我们小宇了。成绩的事我们回家自己说。对了小宇，你最近搭的那个航母模型，给奶奶和婶婶讲讲？
note: 问题冲着孩子来时由大人接住，一句挡掉，再把话题转到孩子愿意说的事上；第二次再问就原话再说一遍。

situation: I've been sober for eight months. At every family barbecue my uncle Dave hands me a beer, and when I say no he jokes 'what, you pregnant or something?' His 60th is on Saturday and I don't want to explain my recovery to the whole patio.
reply: Ha, nope, not pregnant, just on the lemonade today, Uncle Dave. Pass me one of those, would you? And tell me, how does sixty feel so far?
note: No reason for not drinking, since a reason invites a debate; if he pushes again, repeat the same line and keep a drink of your own in hand. If the pressure starts to shake your recovery, call your support group or a recovery helpline before the party.

situation: I'm gay and out to my parents, but not to my 85-year-old grandma Rose. Every visit she asks if I've 'found a nice girl yet'. I don't want to lie to her and I'm not ready to tell her. Lunch at hers on Sunday.
reply: Ha, Grandma, you never give up. When there's someone to bring to Sunday lunch, you'll get to meet them. Now, what have you been up to this week?
note: A non-answer is not a lie: nothing in it says 'girl', it holds word for word if she asks again, and it still works if you decide to tell her later.

situation: 国庆第一次带男朋友小陈回老家见亲戚。我舅妈说话很直，肯定会当着他的面问他家有没有房、一年挣多少。她做的桂花糖藕是一绝。我不想让他难堪，也不想跟舅妈闹僵。
reply: 哈哈，舅妈一上来就查户口呀。我们俩的事心里有数，有好消息第一个跟您说。对了舅妈，您的桂花糖藕今天做了没？小陈第一次来，可得让他尝尝。
note: 问题冲着伴侣来时由你来接，不替他报任何数字；她再问就原话再说一遍，事前也跟男朋友通个气。

situation: I was laid off in August and I'm job hunting. At Sunday dinner my uncle Ray asked 'so, found anything yet?' and I said 'When there's news, you'll hear it first' and asked about his fishing trip. Twenty minutes later he's asking again in front of everyone.
reply: When there's news, you'll hear it first, Uncle Ray. Now, you never told me what you actually caught on that fishing trip.
note: The second time, repeat the same line almost word for word; a new answer gives him a new angle.

situation: Estamos en la comida del domingo en casa de mi tía Maribel. Ya me ha preguntado dos veces cuándo vamos a dejar de 'tirar el dinero en alquiler', y ahora lo ha soltado delante de todos: 'a vuestra edad ya deberíais tener algo propio'. Su hija Lucía acaba de volver de hacer el Camino de Santiago.
reply: Tía, el tema del piso lo dejo aparcado, hoy no voy a hablar de eso. Si vuelve a salir, me voy a la cocina a echar una mano. Oye, Lucía, ¿qué tal el Camino? Cuéntanos cuál fue la etapa más dura.
note: Tercera vez y con pulla: versión firme, sin explicar vuestras finanzas, y el giro hacia Lucía cambia el foco sin dejar mal a la tía.

situation: 年夜饭上，我已经跟姑姑说过两次“结婚这个话题不聊了”。她刚才又当着全家人说：“三十五了还嫁不出去，肯定是自己有问题。”这次明显是故意让我难堪。
reply: 我出去透透气，十分钟就回来。
note: 对方是故意刻薄，不是说话笨：不回嘴、不解释，一句话起身离开几分钟，回来后照常聊别的。

situation: We adopted our daughter Lucia (6) from Colombia. At Easter my aunt Pam asked right in front of her whether we know anything about 'her real mother', and I'm sure she'll ask again at Sunday lunch at hers. Lucia spent this morning drawing a dinosaur for Pam.
reply: We keep Lucia's story in the family for now; it's hers to share when she's older. Lucia, do you want to show Aunt Pam the dinosaur you drew for her this morning?
note: The child is listening, so the line is calm and final. If Pam returns to it, a word with her alone later works better than a firmer line at the table.

situation: I've been a stay-at-home dad since our twins were born two years ago, and my wife Priya and I are happy with the arrangement. Her dad, Gerald, keeps asking at family lunches 'so when are you going back to real work?' He's been building a garden bench in his new workshop. Lunch at theirs on Sunday.
reply: Ha, the twins keep me plenty busy, Gerald. Priya and I are happy with how it's working. Now, did you finish that bench, or is it still in pieces in the workshop?
note: No defending the arrangement to an in-law; if he asks again, repeat the same line nearly word for word.

situation: 我32岁，我妈又没问我就给我约了相亲，这周六下午见她同事的儿子。前两次我都去了，这次不想去，以后也不想她再帮我约。周六下午我正好有空，可以回家陪她吃饭。她最近在跟小区阿姨们排广场舞准备比赛。在微信上回她。
reply: 妈，我知道您是替我操心。这周六的相亲我不去了，麻烦您跟阿姨说一声抱歉，以后这类安排也先别帮我约了。周六下午我回家陪您吃饭，顺便看看您比赛的舞排得怎么样了？
note: 不解释为什么不想相亲，解释会变成新一轮劝说；她再提，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: 我今年高三，每次家里聚会舅舅都当着一桌人问我模拟考多少分、想考哪个大学，还说“考不上985就白读了”。这周六外婆过八十大寿，一大家子吃饭。舅舅最近迷上了钓鱼。
reply: 哈哈，舅舅又来查成绩啦。等有结果了，第一个告诉您。对了舅舅，听说您最近迷上钓鱼了，钓到过大的没？
note: 高中生也可以这样接：不报分数、不说目标，直接转到钓鱼；他再问，就原话再说一遍。

situation: My dad's wake is on Saturday and I know my cousin Gary will ask me, probably in front of people, who's getting Dad's house. My sister Claire and I haven't sorted the will yet and we're not discussing it with anyone. Gary and Dad went fishing together most weekends.
reply: Ah, Gary. That's one for Claire and me to sort out quietly, and not today. Tell me about all those weekends you and Dad spent fishing, I'd love to hear them today.
note: If he asks again, repeat the same line nearly word for word; at a wake, the soft deflection is the whole job.

situation: I'm seven months pregnant with our first, a boy. My father-in-law, Emeka, asks on every family video call whether we'll name him after his late father, Obinna; my husband Chidi and I haven't decided and aren't sharing names before the birth. He's been teaching himself to bake bread since he retired, and the next call is Sunday.
reply: Ha, Papa, you're keeping us on our toes. We're keeping names to ourselves until he arrives, and you'll be one of the first to hear. Now, how did the bread come out this week? Hold it up to the camera.
note: If he asks again, repeat the same line nearly word for word; it covers every name, so it never reads as a no to Obinna.

situation: Depuis qu'il a appris que j'ai été suivie pour une dépression l'an dernier, mon oncle Bernard me demande à chaque repas de famille si je « prends toujours mes cachets ». Je vais bien et je ne veux pas en parler devant tout le monde. Dimanche on fête les 60 ans de ma tante Sylvie, et Bernard vient de se mettre à la randonnée.
reply: Ah, tonton, toujours attentif. Je vais bien, et ma santé, je la garde pour moi. Alors, raconte-moi tes premières randonnées, tu es allé où ?
note: Aucun détail sur le traitement : chaque détail appelle une nouvelle question. S'il insiste, reprendre la même phrase presque mot pour mot.

situation: 我前阵子在手臂上纹了一小枝桂花。国庆回老家吃饭，表姨一看见就当着一桌人问：“纹这个以后还怎么找工作？你妈也不管管？”表姨家今年刚换了新车，她特别爱聊。
reply: 哈哈，表姨眼尖。我喜欢，也想好了，您放心。对了，听说您家今年换了新车，开着感觉怎么样？
note: 外表的事不解释、不辩护，也不接“你妈也不管管”这句；她再提，就原话再说一遍。

situation: 我和未婚夫明年五一结婚，我们商量好只办五桌，请最亲的家人和朋友。我妈每次打电话都说至少要办三十桌，“亲戚们都等着呢”。她最近在挑婚礼那天穿的旗袍。
reply: 妈，我知道您是想热热闹闹的，让亲戚们都来沾沾喜气。桌数我们俩已经定了，就五桌，这个不改了。对了，您那件旗袍挑好了吗？发张照片给我看看。
note: 不解释为什么只办五桌，理由一出口就会变成讨价还价；她再提，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: It's an election year, and my father-in-law, Walt, asks me at every Sunday dinner who I'm voting for, then lectures me whatever I say. I keep my vote private. He just finished restoring a 1968 pickup and loves talking about it.
reply: Ha, Walt, my ballot is the one secret I keep. I'll be voting, and that's all I'm sharing. Now tell me about the pickup, has it been out on the road yet?
note: Use the same line every time he asks; any reason you give becomes the start of the lecture.

situation: 我男朋友阿凯离过婚，有个6岁的女儿。奶奶知道后，每次视频都劝我“别找二婚的”。我们感情很好，我不想跟奶奶争，也不想替他解释。奶奶最近在阳台上养了几盆多肉，天天拿给我看。
reply: 奶奶，我知道您是心疼我。阿凯的事我心里有数，您放心。对了，您阳台那几盆多肉怎么样了？拿近点给我瞧瞧。
note: 不替伴侣解释过去，解释只会引来更多劝说；她下次再提，就原话再说一遍。

situation: 我吃素两年了，每次去奶奶家吃饭，她都往我碗里夹肉，说“不吃肉哪来的营养，你看你脸色”。我跟她解释过好几次，没用。这周日去她家吃饭，她最近在学做手工月饼，天天在家族群里发照片。
reply: 奶奶，我现在这样吃挺好的，肉您自己多吃点。您这几天在群里发的手工月饼，我看了好几回了，今天能教我做一个吗？
note: 不讲营养、不再解释，一句不展开的回答接上她爱聊的事；她再夹，就笑着说同一句话。

situation: 我和老公结婚五年，已经商量好不要孩子。公公每次家宴都当着一桌人说“趁年轻赶紧生，不然以后后悔”。他最近在练毛笔字，前几天说在写一幅“宁静致远”。
reply: 爸，这事我们俩心里有数，就不在饭桌上聊了。您那幅“宁静致远”写好了没？拿出来给我们看看呗。
note: 决定了就不必解释，也不暗示“以后再说”；他再提就重复同一句，第三次再用更坚定的说法。

situation: 我下个月结婚。国庆家宴上，三姨肯定会当着一桌人问“男方给了多少彩礼”，还会拿她儿媳家比。彩礼是我们两家私下商量好的，双方都满意，我不想说数字。三姨最近在学跳交谊舞，一聊起来就停不下来。
reply: 哈哈，三姨一上来就问重点。这事两家已经商量好了，我们都挺满意的。对了三姨，听说您最近在学交谊舞，学到哪一步了？
note: 不报数字也不解释，数字一出口就会被拿去比较；她再问，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: 女儿下个月办满月酒，她跟我姓，这是我和老公商量好的，公婆也同意。老公的堂伯说话很冲，肯定会当着一桌人问“孩子怎么跟妈姓，是不是倒插门”。堂伯今年刚抱上孙子，三句话离不开他孙子。
reply: 哈哈，堂伯一来就问到点子上了。这是我们一家人商量好的，大家都挺满意。对了，您家小孙子现在多重了？有照片没，给我们看看。
note: 不解释为什么跟妈姓，也不接“倒插门”那半句；他再问，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: I'm 72 and widowed four years. Since I started seeing Harold, a retired teacher I met at the library, my son Paul asks on every phone call whether Harold is 'after the house' and whether we're going to marry. I'm not discussing my relationship or my money with him. Paul has just started coaching his daughter's soccer team.
reply: Ha, Paul, the tables have turned. Harold and I are happy, and that's all I'm sharing. Now tell me, how's the coaching going with the soccer team?
note: No reassurance about the house or a wedding, since every detail becomes the next question; if he asks again, repeat the same line nearly word for word.

situation: Since my brother moved to Canada, my dad asks on every Sunday phone call when I'm going to take over his hardware shop, which has been his life for 30 years. I'm a nurse, I love my job, and I'm not taking the shop on, but I've never said so outright. He's been restoring his old motorbike since the summer.
reply: Dad, I know how much the shop means to you. I'm staying in nursing, so it won't be me who takes it on, and I'd rather you hear that straight from me than keep wondering. Now, how's the motorbike coming along?
note: A deflection here would keep him hoping, so give the answer once, plainly, with no reasons to argue with; if he asks again, repeat the same line.

situation: 我在深圳工作，攒了一些钱。我妈打电话说弟弟明年结婚要买房，让我出20万帮他凑首付，说“你是姐姐，应该的”。我不打算出这笔钱，也不想跟她吵；弟弟婚礼那天我会包个红包。我妈最近在跟邻居学打太极。
reply: 妈，我知道您是为弟弟的婚事着急，想让他早点安个家。这20万我不出，这件事我想好了。弟弟结婚那天，我这个当姐姐的红包一定到。对了，您跟邻居学的太极打得怎么样了？
note: 直接的要求要给明确的答复，但不解释存款和理由，理由一出口就会变成讨价还价；她再提，就用几乎一样的话再说一遍。

situation: My partner Sam and I got married at the registry office in August with just two witnesses. My aunt Bev keeps asking when we're having 'the proper wedding' and says this one 'doesn't really count'. We're not planning another one. She's hosting her own 40th anniversary party next month, and I'll see her at Sunday lunch.
reply: Ha, Aunt Bev, it counted, I was there. Sam and I are married and very happy, and there's no second wedding planned. Now tell me about your fortieth, how are the party plans coming along?
note: A direct question gets a clear answer with no reasons and no apology for the small wedding; if she says it again, repeat 'married and very happy' word for word.

situation: I moved to Toronto on a work permit two years ago and I'm waiting to hear about permanent residency. My uncle Sanjay asks on every family video call, in front of everyone, 'so are they letting you stay or not?' and then tells stories about people who got sent back. I don't want to share where my application is; he's just back from a cruise and loves talking about it, and the next call is Sunday.
reply: Ha, Sanjay Uncle, still keeping an eye on me. When there's news, you'll be among the first to hear. Now tell me about the cruise, which stop was the best?
note: No status update and no reasons, since every detail invites the next story; if he asks again, repeat the same line nearly word for word.
